pages.title: Horizon Shard
pages.text: A sliver of event horizon, carried out of a black hole simulating a universe of its own. By the holographic principle the horizon area stores everything that ever fell inward, so this shard is less a surface than an archive. It is black from every angle and slightly cold, as Hawking radiation would predict.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)The Eye of the Event Horizon computes a whole universe on a black hole's surface. Seeding a fresh simulation with a universe seed, liquid spacetime and an existing shard, I found a new sliver of horizon peeled off as the simulated cosmos ended.
